tasks.subject: Task 1: Tailwind, PWA module, and app shell
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Get Tailwind CSS v4 compiling, the PWA module producing a manifest + service worker, and the app shell rendering pages instead of the Nuxt welcome screen.

**Files:**
- Modify: `nuxt.config.ts`
- Create: `app/assets/css/main.css`
- Create: `public/icon.svg`
- Modify: `app/app.vue`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds with no Tailwind/PWA config errors.
- [ ] `.output/public/manifest.webmanifest` (or equivalent PWA output) is generated and references `icon.svg`.
- [ ] `app/app.vue` renders `<NuxtPage />` so route pages display.

**Verify:** `npm run build` → ends with `✨ Build complete!`

**Steps:** Install `@vite-pwa/nuxt`, `qrcode.vue`, `@tailwindcss/vite`, `tailwindcss`; add `app/assets/css/main.css` Tailwind entry; add `public/icon.svg` placeholder icon; rewrite `nuxt.config.ts` with `ssr: false`, Tailwind vite plugin, and `@vite-pwa/nuxt` module + manifest config; rewrite `app/app.vue` to render `<NuxtPage />`; verify build; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["nuxt.config.ts", "app/assets/css/main.css", "public/icon.svg", "app/app.vue"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["npm run build succeeds", "manifest generated referencing icon.svg", "app.vue renders NuxtPage"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Ticket config composable
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Independent, `localStorage`-backed reactive config for Posh and Plots, seeded with each screenshot's example content.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/composables/useTicketConfig.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `usePoshConfig()` and `usePlotsConfig()` each return a distinct reactive object seeded with the screenshot values.
- [ ] Edits to one does not affect the other.
- [ ] Values persist across a page reload via `localStorage`.

**Verify:** `npm run build` → ends with `✨ Build complete!`

**Steps:** Write `app/composables/useTicketConfig.ts` exporting `TicketConfig`, `usePoshConfig()`, `usePlotsConfig()` backed by `useState` + `localStorage` sync via `watch`; verify build; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/composables/useTicketConfig.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["usePoshConfig and usePlotsConfig are independent", "values persist via localStorage"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: TicketQr component
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A reusable QR code renderer with an optional centered logo overlay (used by Posh's "(P)" badge, not by Plots).

**Files:**
- Create: `app/components/TicketQr.vue`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Renders a scannable QR code for a given `value` prop with no network request (client-side generation).
- [ ] An optional `#logo` slot renders centered on top of the QR code when provided; nothing overlays it when omitted.

**Verify:** `npm run build` → ends with `✨ Build complete!`

**Steps:** Write `app/components/TicketQr.vue` wrapping `qrcode.vue`'s `QrcodeVue` component with `value`/`size` props and an absolutely-positioned `#logo` slot; verify build; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/components/TicketQr.vue"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["QR renders client-side", "optional logo slot overlays centered"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: TicketConfigForm component
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One shared form (image upload, price, event title, ticket title) bound to whichever config object the page passes in.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/components/TicketConfigForm.vue`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Selecting an image file updates `imageDataUrl` to a base64 data URL.
- [ ] Editing price/event title/ticket title updates the bound config object live (no submit button).

**Verify:** `npm run build` → ends with `✨ Build complete!`

**Steps:** Write `app/components/TicketConfigForm.vue` using `defineModel<TicketConfig>()`, a file input converting to a data URL via `FileReader`, and text/number inputs bound with `v-model`; verify build; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/components/TicketConfigForm.vue"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["image upload sets imageDataUrl", "all four fields are live-bound"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Posh screen (Image 2)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The Order # / Breakdown / Apple Wallet screen, matching Image 2, wired to `usePoshConfig()`.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/components/PoshTicket.vue`
- Create: `app/pages/posh.vue`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Event title renders uppercase in the white card; ticket title and price appear in the Breakdown row; price also appears as the Total.
- [ ] QR code has the centered "(P)" badge.
- [ ] No image is rendered anywhere on this screen.
- [ ] `/posh` shows the config form above the live preview, and edits update the preview immediately.

**Verify:** `npm run build` → ends with `✨ Build complete!`; then `npm run dev` and visually compare `http://localhost:3000/posh` against Image 2 at an iPhone-width viewport.

**Steps:** Write `app/components/PoshTicket.vue` (order header, white card with event title/date/QR+badge/order number, dark Breakdown section, action rows) reading from `usePoshConfig()`; write `app/pages/posh.vue` combining `TicketConfigForm` (v-model on the Posh config) with `PoshTicket`; verify build; manual visual check against Image 2; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/components/PoshTicket.vue", "app/pages/posh.vue"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["uppercase event title", "Breakdown shows ticketTitle/price/Total", "QR has (P) badge", "no image rendered", "form edits update preview live"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Home page and end-to-end verification
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Home page picker linking to `/posh` and `/plots`, plus a full pass confirming the PWA is installable and both screens work end-to-end.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/pages/index.vue`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `/` shows a "PartyPooper" heading with two large tappable options, "Posh" and "Plots", navigating to `/posh` and `/plots` respectively.
- [ ] Editing a field on `/posh`, reloading, and revisiting `/posh` shows the edited value (localStorage persistence).
- [ ] Editing a field on `/plots` does not change anything shown on `/posh`, and vice versa.
- [ ] Chrome DevTools → Application tab shows a valid manifest (name "PartyPooper", standalone display) and a registered, activated service worker.

**Verify:** `npm run build` → ends with `✨ Build complete!`; then the manual checks in the plan's Task 7 Step 3.

**Steps:** Write `app/pages/index.vue` with the Posh/Plots picker; verify build; run the 6-point manual end-to-end verification listed in the plan (navigation, live preview updates on both screens, localStorage persistence, config independence, DevTools manifest + service worker check); commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/pages/index.vue"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["home page links to /posh and /plots", "localStorage persistence confirmed", "config independence confirmed", "manifest and service worker valid in DevTools"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
